title: jacobaea tibetica
intro: Jacobaea tibetica, commonly known as Tibetan Senecio, is a plant species native to the Himalayas and Tibet. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. Jacobaea tibetica is used to treat fever, cough, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Jacobaea tibetica include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
